items.detail: As prescribed. Consistent time of day.

daily.title: Eat
daily.note: Protein is the non-negotiable — 1.8–2.2 g per kg per day. Four anchors of 35–45 g beats trying to rescue the number at dinner. The failure mode isn't one light day, it's three in a row.

items.detail: Greek yoghurt or skyr + eggs, or a shake with milk.
Palm-and-a-half of chicken / fish / beef / tofu.
The one that usually rescues the day's total.
Pale straw, not clear. Creatine raises water needs slightly.
Only needed for the first 2–3 weeks, to calibrate. After that you'll know your portions by eye.
Any time of day. No loading phase needed.

daily.title: Care
daily.note: Minoxidil every evening, except on microneedling days — the skin needs about a day and a half to close up before anything goes on it again.

items.detail: Morning. Every 14 days. No minoxidil this evening — resume tomorrow evening.
Evening, on dry scalp. Hides itself automatically on microneedling days.

daily.title: Train
daily.note: Ticked for you when you finish a workout on the exercise page — you do not need to tick it by hand.

items.detail: One full equipment-free session, up to three a week. Signed off on the exercise page.
Short sleep measurably suppresses muscle gain and raises appetite. Consistent wake time matters more than consistent bedtime.
Ticked for you. Untick it on a day you did smoke — that is the only thing stored, and it costs the 15 XP a clean day pays.
Not in the hour after training — cold blunts the growth signal.

oneOffs.title: Setup
oneOffs.note: These disappear for good once ticked.

items.detail: Morning, unflexed, before eating. This is the one thing here that gets worse by waiting — a starting number taken next week isn't a starting number.
